cards.title: Aggregation and Weighting of MIC Distributions
cards.claim: MIC distributions are aggregated from worldwide sources. 'Aggregated weighted distributions' convert each individual distribution to contribute equally to the common distribution, preventing large datasets from drowning out smaller ones.
conditions: Data must be representative of reference broth microdilution (ISO-20776-2) or calibrated methods
Truncated distributions at the lower end are excluded
required_inputs: Multiple MIC distributions from various sources/geographies/time periods
limitations: Different methods do not give exactly the same results (variation up to one doubling dilution)
Cannot be used to infer rates of resistance or compare resistance over time/geography
cards.downstream_use: Provides a robust reference distribution for wild-type susceptibility calibration.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
